The Marid (blue djinns) and the Efreet (green djinns) are at war in the desert. Ally with the Marid of {wiki:Ashta'daramai|Ashta'daramai}: get a recipe book for the cook, fetch a spy's report from the enemy fortress and swap the lamp of the Efreet leader, {npc:Malor}, for a cursed one. At the end you can trade with {npc:Haroun} and {npc:Nah'Bob}, you receive 3 {item:Small Sapphire|Small Sapphires} and you can hunt Efreets and Green Djinns.
